Tailoring Character

A 107° peak with a normal curved gorge sits near the dramatic end of traditional tailoring:

Broader and more open than a 105° peak.
Less severe than an RL peak.
Creates a powerful V-shape.
Often seen in fashion-forward double-breasted coats, ceremonial jackets, and bespoke showpieces.
